final: WITH g AS (SELECT si.healtheval AS st, AVG(s.gbsize * 1.0 / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS rate, COUNT(DISTINCT s.zoneref) AS nsites FROM scans s JOIN sites si ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry GROUP BY si.healtheval), o AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS a FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(g.nsites * 1.0) AS avg_sites, AVG(g.rate - o.a) AS avg_excess FROM g, o WHERE o.a IS NOT NULL AND g.rate > o.a
